My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Your item arrived damaged. According to our warranty information, you should report the damage promptly so it can be evaluated. After review, you will receive the next steps. In some cases, a replacement part may be sent if it is easy to install; otherwise, the item may need to be sent in for inspection.
Key details from our policy:
- If the product is found to be defective, it may be repaired or replaced at no charge.
- If inspection is required, you may initially need to ship the product to us.
- If the product is confirmed defective, shipping costs can be reimbursed with valid proof of payment, and we cover return shipping back to you.
To proceed, please:
1. Keep the damaged item and all packaging.
2. Take clear photos of the damage and the packaging.
3. Be prepared to submit a warranty or damage claim with those details.
If you are signed in, the system can assist in looking up your order details in the next message. If you prefer, I can connect you with a human representative. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
